name: Stalker
ability: On your 1st night, select a player. When they die, you learn their alignment that night.
flavor: You’re always watching. Quiet. Creeping. Just close enough to catch a killer mid-swoop— but never too close to become the prey.
firstNightReminder: The Stalker chooses a player: mark them STALKED.
otherNightReminder: If the STALKED player died, show a thumbs up (good) or down (evil).

name: Coroner
ability: Each night, choose a player: if they die before you next wake, your vote counts as 2 the next day.
flavor: You've seen more autopsies than takeoffs. One more body and you’re ready to pass judgment.
firstNightReminder: The Coroner chooses a player: mark them CHOSEN.
otherNightReminder: If the CHOSEN player died tonight, mark the Coroner DOUBLED. The Coroner chooses a player.

name: Engineer
ability: Each night, learn how many evil abilities were used since the last dawn.
flavor: You don't trust anyone unless you've personally checked their wiring… or minion tampering.
otherNightReminder: Give a finger signal.

name: Mortician
ability: Each night, select a living player. If they die, you learn their role that night.
flavor: If someone dies, you’re there with a notepad, gloves, and an eerie sense of glee.
firstNightReminder: The Mortician chooses a player: mark them CHOSEN.
otherNightReminder: If the CHOSEN player died, show their character token. The Mortician chooses a player.

name: Birdwatcher
ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn if an evil ability chose them tonight.
flavor: You watch from the rafters, silent and still—always hoping what you spot is just a goose, and not something more sinister.
firstNightReminder: The Birdwatcher chooses a player. Nod if an evil ability chose them tonight.
otherNightReminder: The Birdwatcher chooses a player. Nod if an evil ability chose them tonight.

name: Fortune Teller
ability: Each night, choose a living player: if they die before you next wake, you learn 3 players, one of whom is responsible.
flavor: You don’t see the killer’s face… but you know they’re among a trio of beady-eyed suspects.
firstNightReminder: The Fortune Teller chooses a player: mark them CRYSTAL BALL.
otherNightReminder: If the CRYSTAL BALL player died, point to 3 players including the one responsible. The Fortune Teller chooses a player.

name: Scientist
ability: Each night*, you learn how many Geese made bird noises today.
flavor: You’re not here to play games. You’re here to log, observe, and publish peer-reviewed statistics on honks.
otherNightReminder: Give a finger signal.

name: Medium
ability: Each night*, choose good, evil, or a character type: you learn how many dead players are that.
flavor: You’ve plucked more than feathers — the dead whisper secrets if you listen close enough.
otherNightReminder: The Medium chooses good, evil, or a character type. Give a finger signal.

name: Sensor
ability: Each night*, you learn how many of today's votes were cast by evil players.
flavor: You don’t need to hear their lies—you can feel the pressure of their thumbs pressing injustice into motion.
otherNightReminder: Give a finger signal.

name: Sheriff
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a living player. If they are evil they die, if they are good, you both die.
flavor: Justice honks for no duck. But shoot the wrong one, and you’ll go down quacking together.
otherNightReminder: The Sheriff may choose a player. If evil, they die. If good, both they and the Sheriff die.

name: Bodyguard
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: if they would die tonight, you die instead.
flavor: You signed up to take a bullet for someone. Let’s hope they were worth it.
otherNightReminder: The Bodyguard may choose a player: mark them PROTECTED.

name: Detective
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: you learn if they have caused another player's death.
flavor: You’ve connected the dots, matched the feathers, and found the blood beneath the beak.
otherNightReminder: The Detective may choose a player. Nod if they have caused a death.

name: Lobbyist
ability: Once per game, if you are nominated and not executed, that night choose a player: they die.
flavor: Even a vote against you is a vote for you — if your charm survives the ballot box.
otherNightReminder: If the Lobbyist survived a nomination today and still has their ability, they may choose a player: they die.

name: Astral
ability: Once per game, during the day, privately choose a player: you learn if they woke last night.
flavor: You drift between realms, watching for movement in the night — or just really nosy dreams.

name: Gravy
ability: If you are targeted at night, one of your alive neighbors might be targeted instead.
flavor: Mmm… sweet, buttery safety. But someone nearby may just get the splatter instead.

name: Celebrity
ability: If the Demon kills you, a good player learns that the Demon killed you.
flavor: The cameras never lie. If you're taken out, someone’s definitely going to hear about it.
otherNightReminder: If the Demon killed the Celebrity, wake a good player and show them the Celebrity token: the Demon did it.

name: Canadian
ability: If the Demon kills you, "O Canada" plays for the Demon, and no other Townsfolk can die until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: You fall with honor, flag in hand. Let your anthem echo — no other shall fall while your spirit stands.
otherNightReminder: If the Demon killed the Canadian, wake the Demon and play "O Canada". Mark the Canadian EH: no other Townsfolk can die until dusk tomorrow.

name: Survivalist
ability: If you are alive in the final 3, your vote counts as 2.
flavor: You've made it this far by eating berries, hiding in bushes, and trusting absolutely no one.

name: Lover
ability: You start knowing a good player and their character. If you are both alive in the final 3, you both win. If one of you dies, the other dies too.
flavor: You weren’t here for the mystery. Just… for them. And you’ll go down together if it comes to it.
firstNightReminder: Point to a good player and show their character token. Mark them LOVER.
otherNightReminder: If the Lover or the LOVER player died, the other dies too.

name: Goose
ability: You think you are another character.
flavor: You’re strutting through the game, certain you’ve got an important job to do. Shame you’re just… a Goose playing pretend.

name: Pigeon
ability: Each night*, your alignment changes if you voted on every living person (not yourself) in the previous day.
flavor: One vote at a time, you’re infecting the game with confusion. When the spread is complete... who are you really?
otherNightReminder: If the Pigeon voted on every other living player today, they change alignment: show a thumbs up (good) or down (evil).

name: Dodo
ability: If you are executed, you win (alone). If there are 2 Dodos, you win only by getting the other executed. You might register as either alignment, even if dead. [+0 to +1 Dodo]
flavor: You crave the sweet, sweet chaos of a glorious self-destruction. Get voted out. Win alone. Die happy.

name: Spy
ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn their character. You might register as a good Townsfolk or Outsider.
flavor: You blend in like a mallard in a pond of geese. No one suspects the quiet one watching everything.
firstNightReminder: The Spy chooses a player: show their character token.
otherNightReminder: The Spy chooses a player: show their character token.

name: Demolitionist
ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn their character type. If either of their alive neighbors is executed tomorrow, they die too.
flavor: You’ve rigged the neighborhood. One wrong move and the chain reaction begins.
firstNightReminder: The Demolitionist chooses a player: mark them BOMB and give a finger signal for character type.
otherNightReminder: The Demolitionist chooses a player: mark them BOMB and give a finger signal for character type.

name: Serial Killer
ability: On night 1, choose a player: they become a Goose. If they are executed, the next night you choose a player to kill and a new target. [-1 Outsider]
flavor: You smile politely. Then you twist the knife. The blood doesn’t bother you anymore.
firstNightReminder: The Serial Killer chooses a player: mark them TARGET and IS A GOOSE.
otherNightReminder: If the TARGET was executed today, the Serial Killer chooses a player to kill, then a new TARGET.

name: Preacher
ability: Each night, you learn how many good players woke tonight to use their ability. You may choose a player: their vote counts as 2 tomorrow. [+1 Outsider]
flavor: You’ve got faith — faith that your voice will twist this flock into madness.
firstNightReminder: Give a finger signal. The Preacher may choose a player: mark them DOUBLED.
otherNightReminder: Give a finger signal. The Preacher may choose a player: mark them DOUBLED.

name: Clown
ability: Each night*, choose a player: tomorrow, they must speak only in falsetto. If they don't, you may kill them tonight.
flavor: You squawk, they squawk — but some honks are fatal. Comedy is murder.
otherNightReminder: If yesterday's CLOWNED player broke the rule, the Clown may kill them. The Clown chooses a player: mark them CLOWNED; wake them and show the Clown token.

name: Professional
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die, but appear alive until tomorrow night.
flavor: No one even sees you kill. They’re still walking around — poisoned, fake-smiling, and dying slowly.
otherNightReminder: The IS DEAD player now dies publicly. The Professional chooses a player: mark them IS DEAD (they appear alive tomorrow).

name: Morphling
ability: Each night, choose a player: they die the following night. If they are a Townsfolk, they become a Goose, and you gain and register as their ability. [-1 Outsider]
flavor: You steal not just their life, but their role. Why be suspicious when you can be... them?
firstNightReminder: The Morphling chooses a player: mark them DOOMED. If a Townsfolk, they become a Goose; give the Morphling their token with IS THE MORPHLING.
otherNightReminder: The DOOMED player dies. The Morphling chooses a player: mark them DOOMED. If a Townsfolk, they become a Goose; give the Morphling their token with IS THE MORPHLING.

name: Cupid
ability: Each night, choose 2 players, one will die the following night. If either are executed, they both die.
flavor: Love is a weapon. Two hearts, one bullet. You’ll make them fall — then make them fall harder.
firstNightReminder: The Cupid chooses 2 players: mark them CONNECTED.
otherNightReminder: If neither CONNECTED player was executed, one of them dies. The Cupid chooses 2 players: mark them CONNECTED.

name: Cannibal
ability: Each night*, pick a player, they die. If an evil player was recently killed, you gain their ability until the next evil player dies.
flavor: Evil tastes best with a little seasoning. You devour their abilities like a buffet of betrayal.
otherNightReminder: If an evil player has died since last night, give the Cannibal their ability (IS THE CANNIBAL). The Cannibal chooses a player: they die.

name: Vigilante
ability: Once per game, at night, after your 2nd day: choose a player who voted today on someone of your alignment. If they are the opposite alignment, they die.
flavor: You don’t wait for orders. You wait for justification. Just give you one reason and you’ll pull the trigger.
otherNightReminder: The Vigilante may choose a player who voted today on someone of the Vigilante's alignment. If that player is the opposite alignment, they die.

name: Locksmith
ability: Each night, pick a player. If they are a Goose and you are good, they become the townsfolk they saw. If they are a townsfolk and you are evil, they become a Goose.
flavor: Keys can open minds too. You're unlocking the truth, one identity at a time.
firstNightReminder: The Locksmith chooses a player. If the Locksmith is good and they are a Goose, remove IS A GOOSE. If evil and they are a Townsfolk, add IS A GOOSE.
otherNightReminder: The Locksmith chooses a player. If the Locksmith is good and they are a Goose, remove IS A GOOSE. If evil and they are a Townsfolk, add IS A GOOSE.

name: Pelican
ability: Each night*, choose a player you haven't chosen before. When you die, one of the players you chose comes back to life.
flavor: Your gullet hides many secrets, and you plan to regurgitate only the ones that suit your goals.
otherNightReminder: The Pelican chooses a new player: mark them BELLY.

name: Vulture
ability: Once per game, at night*, pick a dead player and gain their ability.
flavor: You circle the battlefield, waiting for the right moment to feast on power long gone cold.
otherNightReminder: If the Vulture hasn't used their ability, they may choose a dead player: the Vulture gains that ability.

name: Falcon
ability: If the number of living evil players (not yourself) is greater than the number of living good players, you die.
flavor: Soaring above, you balance the battlefield. But if evil tips the scales… you plummet.
otherNightReminder: If living evil players (not the Falcon) outnumber living good players, the Falcon dies.

name: Assassin
ability: Once per game, during the day, a player may publicly guess every Goose and who each thinks they are. If all correct, they choose a player: that player dies.
flavor: One strike, one chance. Know your prey, or perish in shame.

name: Silencer
ability: Each day, up to half the living players (rounded up & Travellers don’t count) may communicate using bird noises.
flavor: The air is thick with suspicion—and the haunting echo of chirps. No more words. Only tweets.
